name: Rosalyn
source:
“No obstacle will stop me. Not even fire.”

A young witch obsessed with knowledge—and now, with understanding love. After failing with potions and even trying to remove her own heart, she’s determined to find answers. Even if it means dragging others into her dangerous experiments.
